title: Rhythm
extract: Rhythm generally means a "movement marked by the regulated succession of strong and weak elements, or of opposite or different conditions". It most commonly refers to such a movement of musical beats, for instance in music, poetry, mechanical operations, and biological processes. This general meaning of regular recurrence or pattern in time can apply to a wide variety of cyclical natural phenomena having a periodicity or frequency of anything from microseconds to several seconds ; to several minutes or hours, or, at the most extreme, even over many years.
